title: Classify and prioritize portfolio outcomes and contradictions
description:
As an account operator, I want every selected score to have a clear outcome and the largest contradictions to be prioritized, so that I can distinguish safe automation from policy, evidence, and repair work.

Feature: Portfolio outcome classification

Scenario: Assign one primary disposition
  Given ranking, assessment, diagnosis, optimizer, and evaluation evidence for a selected score
  When the living Report is revised
  Then the score has exactly one primary disposition
  And evidence health and recent activity remain separate visible axes
  And incomplete evidence cannot imply improvement

Scenario: Prioritize contradictions
  Given multiple guideline, code, rubric, feedback, or evidence conflicts
  When contradictions are presented
  Then blockers to active work appear before lower-impact findings
  And ties use reviewed-error exposure, evidence strength, recent worsening, and stable identity
  And the largest findings are explained in ordinary language

Scenario: Preserve non-optimization outcomes
  Given a score needs repair, clarification, targeted collection, monitoring, cooldown, or no safe change
  When the run is summarized
  Then that outcome remains visible without launching an optimizer
